properties.areaDesc: Rock Island Passage to Sturgeon Bay WI
properties.description:
* WHAT...Southwest winds 10 to 20 kt with gusts up to 25 kt and
waves 3 to 5 ft.

* WHERE...Lake Michigan nearshore waters from Washington Island
to Sturgeon Bay.

* WHEN...Until 7 AM CDT this morning.

* IMPACTS...Conditions will be hazardous to small craft.
properties.headline: Small Craft Advisory issued October 19 at 12:54AM CDT until October 19 at 7:00AM CDT by NWS Green Bay WI
properties.instruction:
Inexperienced mariners, especially those operating smaller
vessels, should avoid navigating in hazardous conditions.

NWSheadline: SMALL CRAFT ADVISORY REMAINS IN EFFECT UNTIL 7 AM CDT THIS MORNING
